label: From post-infectious glomerulonephritis to complement-mediated aHUS: a diagnostic challenge.
summary: Post-infectious glomerulonephritis (PIGN) and atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS) can overlap due to alternative complement pathway dysregulation.
